candidate_methods.reason: docs/05A §20 A-W11-04 forbids inventing an unsafe fan obstruction; it also stalls the fan, which is a fault in a different class and changes the safety posture

candidate_methods.method: add a controlled thermal resistance at the hot interface (gasket/dust)
candidate_methods.reason: physically alters the frozen hardware configuration, is not quantified without a hot-base probe, and is only partly reversible; the H8 limit table exists to keep the hot path bounded and this pushes an unmeasured variable into it

candidate_methods.method: move or re-seat a probe to fake a changed reading
candidate_methods.reason: this is a sensor fault, not a thermal-effectiveness fault, and it produces exactly the contamination the 2026-11-02 PROBE_IDENTIFICATION session is excluded for: a hand on a probe. The label would be untrustworthy by construction

candidate_methods.method: hold the door at a fixed small opening
candidate_methods.reason: a steady added load with unchanged heat transfer is a load disturbance, which is S2's mechanism; labelling it S3 would put two names on one physical effect and destroy the contrast Member B trains on

candidate_methods.method: cap duty or current so less power reaches the stack
candidate_methods.reason: reducing the drive is an actuation-response change, which is S4; the electrical response would NOT remain plausible, so it fails S3's first condition by definition

candidate_methods.method: warm the room or the bench environment
candidate_methods.reason: not controllable or repeatable at 1 Hz within a supervised session, and the ambient path is already documented as not the plant (docs/05A §16.3 ambient path is only a candidate); it also changes the baseline every paired run depends on

decisive_reason: thermal effectiveness is a lift per unit power and the lift has no measurable cold endpoint here: hot_base_max_c and cold_plate_min_c are UNRESOLVED because neither probe is installed (firmware/h8-bench/main/h8_limits.c:27), and the frozen geometry places T1/T3/T4 in chamber air and T2 on the TEC hot side
docs03_position: docs/03 §31 already permits omitting S3 from core fault claims when no clean method exists; this record is the evidence for using that clause rather than a preference

required_measurements.evidence: current_status and voltage_status are empty strings in all 957 rows of the committed capture and no power_status column exists
required_measurements.what: electrical power delivered during the degraded state, with producer status
required_measurements.why: S3 is defined by electrical response staying plausible while thermal effectiveness falls; without a qualified power figure the first half of the definition cannot be asserted

required_measurements.evidence: firmware/h8-bench/main/h8_limits.c:27 marks hot_base_max_c UNRESOLVED with NO_HOT_BASE_PROBE_INSTALLED; cold_plate_min_c likewise; the frozen geometry has no probe on the cold plate
required_measurements.what: cold-plate temperature at the TEC interface
required_measurements.why: thermal effectiveness is a temperature lift per unit power; the cold side of the lift is one of the two endpoints

required_measurements.evidence: same unresolved limit row; T2 sits on the TEC hot side, which is not the hot base and is already excluded from chamber-air statistics
required_measurements.why: the other endpoint of the lift, and the place a fouling or contact-resistance degradation would show first

required_measurements.evidence: every candidate method below either changes the frozen configuration, damages hardware, or is not separable from S2
required_measurements.what: a degradation that can be set to a known magnitude and removed identically at least 4 times
required_measurements.why: docs/03 §31 requires the scenario to be reproducible, and Member B needs pairs

required_measurements.evidence: one physical thermal capture is committed, so no between-run spread exists for any derived metric
required_measurements.what: the effectiveness metric measured at least twice in the healthy state
required_measurements.why: a degraded label needs a distribution to be degraded *relative to*

session_record_requirements.record: the cold-plate and hot-base probe ROMs, physical mounting point, and the resolved limit-table rows for hot_base_max_c and cold_plate_min_c
session_record_requirements.why: without both endpoints of the lift there is no thermal-effectiveness quantity to degrade, only chamber air that happens to be warmer

session_record_requirements.record: voltage, current and power for every frame, each with its producer status emitted as OK at the source
session_record_requirements.why: S3 is 'electrical response plausible while thermal effectiveness falls'; an unqualified current cannot carry the plausible half of that sentence

session_record_requirements.record: which method was used, its intended magnitude, how it was set, and how it was removed - identical each time, with the operator present
session_record_requirements.why: docs/03 §31 requires a reproducible scenario; a degradation that cannot be set to a known magnitude cannot become a label

session_record_requirements.record: the same hardware configuration id, firmware version, sensor ROMs, physical positions and duty as the degraded run, immediately before or after it
session_record_requirements.why: effectiveness is a ratio against the healthy state; without a matched pair the degradation is indistinguishable from drift or a different box

session_record_requirements.record: at least 2 healthy and 4 degraded captures, each a separate session with its own boot_id, and the timing of each edge from an operator timer
session_record_requirements.why: a degraded label needs a distribution to be degraded relative to, and one boot's segments are not independent runs

session_record_requirements.record: ambient temperature and humidity, door state with its per-boot attestation, fan readback, any manual intervention, and the end reason
session_record_requirements.why: the S2 door disturbance and an S4 refusal both move chamber air; if they are not recorded they silently contaminate the S3 label

session_record_requirements.record: what was deliberately not attempted (shorted branch, bypassed fuse, damaged TEC, obstructed fan) and why
session_record_requirements.why: docs/05A §20 A-W11-01 forbids those methods; the absence of a record that they were refused is indistinguishable from having quietly used one

verdict_basis: 0 of 5 required measurements are available on the current frozen hardware, and every candidate method violates at least one constraint
warning: if the campaign later wants a thermal-side degradation label at all, the only honest route runs through new instrumentation, not through new manipulation of the existing bench
what_would_change_the_verdict: install a cold-plate probe and a hot-base probe, resolve hot_base_max_c and cold_plate_min_c in the limit table, qualify the electrical columns with a real producer status, and then collect at least 2 healthy and 4 degraded captures
